done_when: The generated forge.yml that gates merging runs the tests as the parallel groups, with one required check that passes only when every group passes, for this repo and for client repos on init and after upgrade and sync

findings.body: Raise: Functional. The split check treats any command containing the word `pytest` as a direct pytest invocation. In a Python client with pytest-split listed in `pyproject.toml` and `test = "make pytest"`, init or sync generates `make pytest --splits 6 --group ...`. Make rejects `--splits`, so the required `tests` check fails even when the suite passes. The documented one-group fallback for commands that are not direct pytest invocations does not apply.
findings.title: Not done: Generated gate fails for Makefile pytest commands

why: The check that gates merging runs the whole suite as one 35-minute job; the six faster test groups run only in a workflow nothing waits on
